positive_snippets:
The room was clean enough for a single night stay with basic facilities like Good Bed, wardrobe, Bathroom, Hot water etc. Ideal for the US Visa applicants as its just 1KM from the Embassy. Staff Chottu was kind & polite to address my concerns.
Got my shirt & Pant ironed, in a few mins (Available within the building). Also helped me with the cab facility in his circle, the driver was ready next morning for Pick up and drop (100Rs +100Rs) for the Visa interview with reasonable pricing & then the same person dropped me to the airport after the interview. I was also able to order online through swiggy for the eatables during lunch and dinner. I was also able to order few things like vaseline & deodorant through Zepto.
Good wifi connectivity is there in the room.

The only issue is this building's weather is very very cold that they've kept the heater in the room, which is of not much helpful. So its important for you to carry a socks , cotton in the ears, sweater to wear during the sleep as its not easy to stay in such a cold environment.

Excellent place to stay
Very near to USA embassy ( visa interview).
Ideal place
